<head-word>גְּרִיצָה</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (גרץ 
<italic>to cut</italic>, cmp. גרס) 
<italic>slice.</italic></definition>
<notes>
<plural-form>Pl. גְּרִיצוֹת</plural-form>
<italic>bread or cake formed of slices twisted together</italic> or 
<italic>layers above one another, twists</italic>. Bets. II, 6 (21
<sup>b</sup>) אין אופין פִּתָּן ג' Ms. M. a. ed. Y. (ed. פִּתִּין גְּרִיצִין, Ar. פתן גריצין) they must not (on Holy Days) bake their bread in the form of twists; Y. ib. 61
<sup>c</sup> bot.—Tosef. Ab. Zar. VII (VIII), 2 מוליכין עמו ג' לתנור you may carry your cakes, to be baked with his, to the confectioner’s oven.—Snh. 100
<sup>b</sup>, v. next w.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="C01346">
<head-word>גְּרִירָה</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (גרר) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>scraping off</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ḥull. 84
<sup>a</sup> מחוסר … וג' requires the acts of pouring out the blood, scraping off the blood stains &c. Ib. 93
<sup>a</sup> ריש מעיא … בעי ג' the top of the small bowels up to a cubit’s length must be scraped (in order to remove the fat).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>dragging, pulling, moving an object without lifting</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. 22
<sup>a</sup>; Pes. 101
<sup>a</sup>; Men. 41
<sup>b</sup> הלכה … בג' the law decides in favor of … with reference to dragging an object on the Sabbath, v. גָּרַר. Y. Kidd. I, 60
<sup>d</sup> top מהו שיקנו בג' can they be taken possession of by moving without lifting?</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>carrying with, involving</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Pes. VII, 34
<sup>c</sup> top מאי נפקא … ג' what is the difference between them? They differ as to the majority of one tribe carrying with it (determining the legal status of) the whole nation, v. גָּרַר 3.—Sabb. 71
<sup>a</sup> ומי אית ליה … ג' does R. adopt the opinion that one action can be involved with another so as to be considered one continuous act (e.g. cutting grain and immediately grinding it)? Ib. ג' דג' an application of this principle in the second degree, that the action involved should involve a third action.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="C01349">
<head-word>גָּרַם</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (v. 
<xref rid="C01393">גרר</xref>) 
<italic>to drag along, carry with it</italic>.</definition>
<notes>—Part. pass. גָּרוּם 
<italic>added in boot, additional measure</italic>, v. גֵּירוּמִין.—אַמָּה גְּרוּמָה 
<italic>a large cubit</italic>. Gen. R. s. 12 [read:] כאמה ג' the size of a liberal cubit (equal to a cubit and a half of strict measure; some ed. גד'; vers. in ‘Rashi’ a. l. גרמידא ומחצה).—Y. Shek. VI, end, 50
<sup>b</sup> אמה גרו', read גְּדוּמָה, v. גָּדַם. [Tosef. Bekh. V, 4 אצבעותיו גרומות Var., ed. Zuck. גְּדוּמֹות.]—Trnsf. 
<italic>to carry with it, to be the cause of, to engender</italic>. דבר הגֹּורֵם לממון something which may be the cause of pecuniary profit or loss. B. Kam. 71
<sup>b</sup> if one steals objects dedicated to the sanctuary for which the original owner is responsible in case of loss &c., he is bound to pay the thief’s fine (כֵּפֶל) to the owner; אלמא דבר הג' למ' כממון דמי which proves that that which may cause a pecuniary loss, is to be considered as the property of him to whom it may cause it. Ib. 98
<sup>b</sup> according to the opinion of R. Shimeon who says דבר הגורם … מיחייב that what is the cause of monetary gain is considered as money, he who burns a note of indebtedness is bound to pay the full amount of the note; a. fr.—Snh. 104
<sup>a</sup> גורם גלות לבניו causes his children to be exiled. Ber. 5
<sup>b</sup> bot. ג' לשכינה וכ' is the cause of the Divine Presence departing from Israel. M. Kat. 25
<sup>a</sup> בבל גָּרְמָה לו Babylonia was the cause (that the Shekhinah did not rest upon him). Ab. Zar. 8
<sup>b</sup> bot. המקום גורם the place makes the act legal, i.e. only in the Temple hall can the Sanhedrin judge capital cases; Snh. 14
<sup>b</sup> המקום ג' only in the Temple hall can a rebellious elder be judged; ib. 87
<sup>a</sup>.—Y. Yeb. I, 2
<sup>c</sup> top דבר שהוא בא מחמת הגורם וכ' if a prohibition arises from a cause (a person that causes it, e.g. the prohibition against C.’s marrying B. because B.’s sister A. is his wife)—when the cause is removed (through A.’s death), the prohibition ceases; but a prohibition which has not its cause in the action of a person (but in natural kinship, e.g. C.’s daughter married to C.’s brother whereby she becomes forbidden to him also as his brother’s wife), is not removed with the removal of the cause of the (additional) prohibition, i.e. C. cannot perform the levir’s marriage with his brother’s wife since she has not ceased to be his daughter; ib. III, beg., 4
<sup>c</sup>; IV, 6
<sup>a</sup> top.—זה וזה גורם 
<italic>a product of combined causes</italic>. Tem. 30
<sup>b</sup> זה וזה ג' אסור a product of combined causes is forbidden, e.g. the offspring of a dam unfitted for the altar, and of a sire fit; Pes. 27
<sup>a</sup>; a. fr.—Ib. 26
<sup>b</sup> זה וזה ג' מי שמעת ליה can you prove that Rabbi adopts the rule forbidding the product of combined causes?—Nidd. 31
<sup>a</sup> (homiletical play on Gen. XLIX, 14) חמור ג' ליששכר the braying of an ass was the cause of Isachar being begotten; Gen. R. s. 99; v. next w.</notes></sense></senses>

<sup>a</sup>; a. fr.—Part. pass. f. מוּגְרֶמֶת an animal slaughtered by a slanting cut. Ib. 18

<binyan-name>Pa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>גָּרֵים</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>

<notes> Targ. Y. II Gen. XXXV, 9 וגָרִימַת וכ' (some ed. וגְרִי' Pe.) and Thou didst strengthen him (in his trouble).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to eat up to the bone, to pick off</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Ps. XXVII, 2 לְגָּרָמָא (Ms. a. Regia לגַמָּרָא, v. גְּמַר).—B. Bath. 22
<sup>a</sup> אדמְגַרְמִיתוּ גרמי וכ' (Ms. M. מגרדיתו fr. גְּרַד; Ar. דמגריסתו fr. גְּרַס; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) in place of picking off bones (receiving scanty instruction) in the school of A., go ye and eat flesh &c.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Af.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אַגְרֵים</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to make substantial, harden</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Prov. VIII, 28 (Var. אוגריס, h. text אמץ).</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="C01354">
<head-word>גַּרְמָא</head-word>
<language-key> ch.,</language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> constr.</definition>
<notes> גֶּרֶם, גְּרַם same, </notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>

<notes> Targ. Gen. II, 23; a. fr. [Targ. Y. Ex. XXVII, 5 גומא read גַּר' or גּוּרְמָא.]—Gen. R. s. 70 [read as Yalk. ib. 124, cmp. Dan. VI, 25) כהדין ג' אנא מהדק לך like a bone I shall crush thee. Ber. 5
<sup>b</sup>; B. Bath. 116
<sup>a</sup>, v. בִּיר.—
<plural-form>Pl. גַּרְמַיָּא, גַּרְמֵי</plural-form>. Targ. Gen. l. c. גַּרְמַי (Y. גְּרָמַי). Targ. Ezek. XXXVII, 4; a. fr.—Targ. Y. Ex. XXXVIII, 4 [read:] גּוּמְרַיָּא וְגַרְמַיָּא or גורמיא וגומריא, v. supra.—B. Bath. 58
<sup>a</sup> חביתא דג' a vessel of bones (an enigmatical phrase for 
<italic>an animal</italic>). Ib. 22
<sup>a</sup>, v. גְּרַם II.—Bets. 11
<sup>a</sup> תברא ג' a block on which bones are chopped; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>body, self</italic>.</definition>
<notes> ג' ג' 
<italic>each for itself, one after the other</italic>. Ib. 11
<sup>b</sup>. Ḥull. 113
<sup>a</sup>.—With suffixes of personal pronouns: גַּרְמִי 
<italic>myself</italic> &c. Targ. Job I, 3 לגַרְמֵיה as his own, לגֶרֶם אתתיה (Ms. לגְרַם) as his wife’s sole property. Targ. Y. Lev. VII, 29 בגַרְמֵיה himself; a. fr.—Gen. R. s. 75, beg., v. גַּפָּא I. Y. Ber. III, 6
<sup>c</sup> bot. קטר גרמיה tied himself; a. fr.—Ber. 48
<sup>a</sup>, a. fr. לג' הוא דעבד he did so for himself, i.e. this is no authoritative precedent.—Y. Orl. I, 61
<sup>a</sup> top ג' אמר he gave his own opinion. Y. Erub. III, 21
<sup>a</sup> bot. בשם גרמיה in his own name; Y. Kidd. II, 63
<sup>a</sup> top.—Y. Keth. III, end, 28
<sup>a</sup> כל גַּרְמָהּ אמרה this very fact (thing) proves; Y. Shebu. V, end, 36
<sup>c</sup>; Y. Keth. IX, beg. 32
<sup>d</sup>; Y. Pes. IX, end, 37
<sup>a</sup> כל גרמא (corr. acc.).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<head-word>גְּרֵיס</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (cmp. גרר, גּוֹרֶן) 
<italic>to scrape together; to collect, accumulate</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Denom. גּוּרְסִינָא. [Targ. Prov. XVIII, 10; V, 19, v. גְּרַם II.]—Trnsf. 
<italic>to acquire knowledge, to commit traditions to memory</italic>, as a preliminary stage to speculation and analysis compared to grinding, v. טחן. Ab. Zar. 19
<sup>a</sup> לעולם יגמר ואע"ג דמשכח ולִיגְרַס ואע"ג דלא ידע וכ' Ms. M. one must at all events acquire readiness (v. גְּמַר II), though one may afterwards forget, and one must study by heart 
<pgbrk id="pg271" />though one does not understand, for Holy Writ says (Ps. CXIX, 20) 
<italic>gar’sah</italic> &c.; it says גָרְסָה and not טָחֲנָה (my soul 
<italic>heaps up</italic>, but not it 
<italic>grinds</italic>, learns but not analyzes); (ed. לִיגְרִיס, and other Variants); Yalk. Ps. 876.—Ber. 8
<sup>a</sup> הוה גְרִיסְנָא בגו ביתאי Ms. M. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) I used to study in my house; Meg. 29
<sup>a</sup>. Ber. l. c. bot. turned his face וגריס and reviewed (what he had learned). Taan. 10
<sup>b</sup> למִיגְרַס to recite traditions, opp. לעיוני to speculate. Ber. 13
<sup>b</sup> (ref. to Deut. XI, 18, v. Targ. Y. a. l.) teach your children …, כי היכי דלִיגְרְסוּ בהו (Ms. M. ונִגְרְסוּ בהו) so that they be able to review them (by themselves); a. fr.—
<italic>Part. act</italic>. גָּרֵיס 
<italic>well-versed, knowing by heart</italic>. B. Bath. 21
<sup>a</sup> ג' ולא דייק knowing Bible verses by heart, but being inexact.—
<italic>Part. pass</italic>. גְּרִיס, f. גְּרִיסָא 
<italic>known by heart</italic>. Men. 32
<sup>b</sup> מיגרס גְּרִיסִין; Meg. 18
<sup>b</sup> מיגרס גְּרִיסָן they are known by heart.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<sup>b</sup>; a. fr.—Y. Yeb. VIII, end, 9
<sup>d</sup>, v. גָּלַע.—[Gen. R. s. 19, a. e. גרעה קומתו, v. גָּוַע.]—
<italic>Part. pass</italic>. גָּרוּעַ 
<italic>inferior. </italic>
<plural-form>Pl. גְּרוּעִים</plural-form>. Gen. R. s. 28. [Ber. 36

<sup>c</sup> bot.; Y. Shebu. VI, beg. 36

<head-word>גָּרַר, </head-word>
<hw-number>I</hw-number>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> v. 
<xref rid="C01286">גָּרָה</xref>) [
<italic>to produce a grating, scraping sound</italic>,] </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to scratch, scrape, shave</italic> (v. 
<xref rid="C01268">גָּרַד</xref>, 
<xref rid="C01379">גָּרַע I</xref>).</definition>
<notes> Sabb. VIII, 6 (81
<sup>a</sup>) כדי לִגְרֹור וכ' (Ar. a. Y. ed. לגרוד) large enough to scrape with it the top &c. R. Hash. 27
<sup>b</sup> גְּרָרֹו Ms. M. (ed. גרדו), v. גֶּלֶד. Keth. 60
<sup>a</sup>; Kerith. 21
<sup>b</sup> גֹּורְרֹו וכ' he must scrape the blood off before eating the bread; a. fr.—Part. pass. גָּרוּר, v. גָּרוּד.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to drag, to move without lifting;</italic>
<alternative>(also neut. verb)</alternative>
<italic>to follow</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. 29
<sup>b</sup>, a. fr. גורר אדם וכ' one may, on the Sabbath, pull or push a couch &c. (on the floor). Y. Kil. I, 27
<sup>b</sup> bot. לא יָגֹור אדם וכ' one must not pull &c. Tanḥ. Thazr. 8 גְּרָרוּהוּ מקברו they dragged him out of his grave. Tosef. Erub. XI (VIII), 13; Tosef. Bets. II, 19 דלת הגֹּורֶרֶת … הגֹּורְרִים (Y. Erub. X, 26
<sup>b</sup> bot. גודרת, corr. acc., v. גָּדַר) a door which drags along the ground (on opening), a matting which is moved by dragging, or large kegs which &c.; Erub. 101
<sup>a</sup> דלת הנִגְרֶרֶת … הנִגְרָר. Cant R. to II, 15 אני גֹורְרוֹ למבולו I will drag him to the flood in which to perish; a. fr.—Tanḥ. Thazr. 9 (ref. to Ps. V, 5 יגרך) אין אתה נגרר … ואין הרעה גֹורֶרֶת אותך וכ' neither art thou dragged behind (attracted by) evil, nor does evil drag (have power over) thee, nor does it dwell with thee; Yalk. Kings 231 אין אתה גורר אחר … גוררת אחריך.—Part. pass. גָּרוּר 
<italic>dragged along, hanging on</italic>.—
<plural-form>Pl. גְּרוּרִים, גְּרוּרִין</plural-form>. Num. R. s. 18 ח' ג' eight threads dragged along (as fringes; Tanḥ. Korah 12 ח' חוטין). Ab. Zar. 3
<sup>b</sup>, a. e. גרים ג' proselytes who have attached themselves but have not been admitted, v. גֵּר.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to carry with it, to cause; to affect</italic> (v. 
<xref rid="C01349">גָּרַם</xref>).</definition>
<notes> Y. Hor. I, 46
<sup>a</sup> bot.; Y. Pes. VII, 34
<sup>c</sup> שבט אחד גֹּורֵר וכ' (a majority of) one tribe affects the legal status of the entire nation, i.e. the majority of tribes (seven) decides, though it may be a minority of the people as a whole. Lev. R. s. 13, end (play on 
<italic>gerah</italic>, Lev. XI, 4 sq.) גָּרְרָה מלכות וכ' carried another government after it, i.e. was followed by another oppressive government. Ab. IV, 2 מצוה גֹורֶרֶת וכ' a good deed begets a good deed &c. Tosef. Sabb. XV (XVI), 6 [read:] אין גֹּורֵר וכ' it is not considered a corpse so as to cause uncleanness to man or vessels.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to saw, split</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. XVII, 2 (122
<sup>b</sup>) a saw (may be used on the Sabbath) לָגֹור בה וכ' (Ms. M. לִגְרֹור, Mish. ed. Pes. לגָרֵר, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) to saw cheese with it. Ohol. XV, 8 עתיד לָגֹור Ar. intended to be sawed apart (ed. לגוד, fr. גדד, v. Tosef. ib. XV, 8). Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. II, 18 לָגֹור וכ' to saw off a part &c.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִגְרַר</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be dragged, pulled</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Erub. X, 11 נגר הנג' a bolt which is dragged along (with the door, i.e. attached and hanging down). Ib. 101
<sup>a</sup>, v. supra. Tanḥ. Thazr. 9, v. supra. Bets. II, 10 (23
<sup>b</sup>) אינה נִגְרֶרֶת; ib. אין נִגְרָרִין must not be dragged or pulled, a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be scraped, planed</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Kam. 119
<sup>b</sup> הנ' במגירה shavings, opp. נפסק במגירה chips.—Nidd. 55
<sup>b</sup> נִגְרָרִין דרך הפה (secretions of the nose) scraped (discharged) through the mouth (v. גָּרַף).</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>גֵּירַר, גֵּרַר</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to drag</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Pes. IV, 9 (56
<sup>a</sup>) ג' עצמות וכ' he had the bones of his father carried out on a bed of ropes. Ib. I, 2 (9
<sup>a</sup>); a. fr.—Tosef. Sabb. VI (VII), 1 (a superstitious custom) המְגָרֶרֶת בנה וכ' Var. (ed. Zuck. המגוררת) one who drags her son among the dead (to the cemetery).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to scrape, plane</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ib. XVI (XVII), 19 מְגָרְרָן he may scrape them (clean his feet of mud). Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. II, 17; Ḥull. 25
<sup>a</sup> עתיד … לגָרֵר requiring planing for finish; a. fr.—Part. pass. מְגֹורָר a) 
<italic>scratched, full of scabs</italic>. Gen. R. s. 64 (play on מגרר, Gen. XXVI, 26) ד"א מג' וכ' another explanation is 
<italic>m’gorar</italic>, for eruptions grew on him (with ref. to Job II, 8); Yalk. ib. 111; v. גָּרַר II. b) 
<italic>planed</italic>. Tosef. Sot. XV, 1 מְגֹורָרוֹת במגר' היו Var. (ed. Zuck. היה מְגָרֵר) the stones were planed with a plane.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִתְגָּרֵר</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be scraped</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tosef. Sabb. XVI (XVII), 19 אין מִתְגָּרְרִין במגוררת ed. Zuck. (Var. מגרדין במגרדת, Sabb. 147
<sup>b</sup> גוררין במגררת, Ms. M. גודרין במגדירה, corr. acc.) one must not be scraped with a strigil. Ib. XXII, 6 (147
<sup>a</sup>) מתגררין, Talm. ed. (Mish. מִתְגָּרְדִין, v. Rabb. D. S. to 147
<sup>b</sup>, note 70).</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>word, utterance, command</italic> (cmp. דִּיבּוּר).</definition>
<notes> B. Bath. 56
<sup>b</sup> (ref. to Deut. XIX, 15) ד' ולא חצי ד' a statement (testimony) but not a partial statement. Mekh. Bo, introd. היה הד' לאהרן (Tanḥ. ib. 5 דבור) the word of the Lord came to &c.; a. fr.—דְּבַר תורה according to the Biblical law. Erub. 81; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. דְּבָרִים,</plural-form> constr. דִּבְרֵי. ד' תורה Biblical laws; ד' סופרים Rabbinical laws. Ib. Yeb. IX, 3; a. fr.—ד' קבלה prophetic exhortations or incidental utterances in other Biblical books than the Pentateuch. Ḥag. 10
<sup>b</sup>; Nidd. 23
<sup>a</sup>; a. e.—B. Mets. 49
<sup>a</sup>; Bekh. 13
<sup>b</sup> ד' יש בהם משום מחוסרי אמנה to word of mouth the rules concerning the faithless are applied, i.e. a verbal agreement is morally binding. B. Mets. 48
<sup>a</sup> הנושא ונותן בד' וכ' he who contracts verbally has no legal claim. Ib. ד' ואיכא … קאי באבל he who retracts a verbal transaction with which a payment of money was connected, comes under the category of those against whom the words ‘but the scholars declared’ (ib. IV, </notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>2)</number>
<definition> has been pronounced.—דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים 
<italic>the Book of Chronicles</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Lev. R. s. 1. B. Bath. 14
<sup>b</sup>.—דָּבָר אַחֵר (abbrev. ד"א) another interpretation (is this). Gen. R. s. 1, beg.; a. fr.—2) 
<italic>thing, affair, object, occurrence</italic> &c. Sot. 28
<sup>b</sup> ד' שיש בו דעת לישאל an object which has sense to ask, i.e. a rational being, opp. ד' שאין וכ' dumb creatures &c.—Num. R. s. 11 ד' שבינך לבינו that which concerns only thy relation to God; v. בֵּין.—ד' שבממון a monetary affair. B. Mets. 94
<sup>a</sup>; a. fr.—ד' הלמד מענינו a thing (law) derived from the context on the very subject. Sifra, introd.; a. fr.—ד' אחר (abbr. ד"א) something not to be named, a) 
<italic>idolatry</italic>. Men. XIII, 10 ואין צריך לומר לד"א much less priests who have been offering to idols; a. fr.—b) 
<italic>swine</italic>. Ber. 43
<sup>b</sup> (prov.) תלה ליה קורא לד"א וכ' hang a palm shoot around the swine and it will follow its habits (of wallowing in the mud). Sabb. 129
<sup>a</sup> sq.; a. e.—c) 
<italic>leprosy</italic> Ib. אי פגע בד"א קשה לד"א if he meets a swine (after blood letting), he is in danger of becoming a leper.—d) 
<italic>unchaste conduct, sexual intercourse, sodomy</italic> &c. Ib. 17
<sup>b</sup> על בנותיהן משום ד"א ועל ד"א משום ד"א they forbade connection with their daughters on account of idolatry, and decreed something else (that a gentile child should be unclean as though afflicted with gonorrhœa) on account of sodomy. Ber. 8
<sup>b</sup> צנועין בד"א chaste in marital life; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. as above.—בעל ד'</plural-form>
<italic>the person to deal with, opponent, party</italic>. B. Mets. 14
<sup>a</sup> לאו ב"ד דידי את I have nothing to do with thee; a. fr.—לא היו ד' מעולם there were no such things, 
<pgbrk id="pg279" />I deny it outright. Shebu. 41
<sup>b</sup>; a. fr.—ד' בגב, ד' בגו, v. גַּב, גֵּו.</notes></sense></senses></entry>
